intent.problem_statement: Add a comprehensive set of mock data to the Digi-check (Audit) that brings 3 Action Items per category (Listing, Reputation, Social Media, Website) and maps them to specific product modules.
success_metrics: Landing -> Registration -> Scan -> Result flow is seamless
Scan results show 3+ action items per category
Clicking an action item redirects to the corresponding feature placeholder

constraints.performance_requirements: Fast loading of mock data, smooth transitions between flow steps
limitations: Features (Master Profile, Reputation Mgmt, etc.) are placeholders for now
Data is hardcoded/mocked for the prototype

logic_flows: Scan Storyteller -> Discovery Dashboard ('We found problems')
Discovery Dashboard -> [Strategic Reveal Transition] -> Priority Action List
Priority Action List -> [Click] -> Deep link to Feature Module
architecture.state_management: Local state / React Context for progress, potentially backend persistence for 'simulated' reality

decisions.resolution: Option B (Strategic Reveal). A multi-stage reveal starting with 'Problems Found' followed by a cinematic transition to a 'Priority Action List'.
Option B (Score Card). 4 large Category Rings showing 'X critical items found', avoiding visual overload initially.
Auto-trigger scan after registration to maintain momentum; no intermediate calibration step.
Option B (The Magic Bridge). A contextual UI that guides the user from the Priority List to the specific field in the module.
Batching Model (Max 3 at once). Items are drip-fed to avoid overwhelming the user. Next batch is revealed upon completion of the current one.
Hybrid Professional German (Online-Präsenz, Kunden-Stimmen, etc.) with English sub-titles.
Option B (Product Tour). The first batch contains 1 item from each major category to demonstrate platform breadth.
Option B (Top Strategy Bar). A high-contrast bar at the top of the module page for clear guidance.
Option B (Choice Moment). A celebratory overlay triggers after the 3rd task, giving the user the choice to continue.
4 Metric Rings: Präsenz-Tiefe, Kunden-Vertrauen, Digitale Reichweite, Web-Integrität. Global score prominently displayed.
Option A (Modal Hijack). The entire onboarding sequence lives as a stateful overlay on the /dashboard route.
Local Storage. Completion state is persisted locally to survive refreshes during prototype testing.
